title: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2608.12847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval can identify a past trajectory that may matter, yet it does not specify how an acting agent should use that trajectory after users, entities, constraints, or environment state have changed. We identify this post-retrieval reuse step as a distinct bottleneck for long-horizon trajectory memory and formulate an evaluation framework that holds candidate retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget fixed while varying the support delivered to the agent. We instantiate the framework with query-conditioned reuse (QCR), a deliberately simple target-bound note that records a reusable procedure, bindings to recover, applicability conditions, and verification requirements. QCR serves to test the reuse hypothesis rather than to claim a universally preferred memory format. translated_title: 超越检索：基于查询条件的长时程智能体轨迹复用
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.12847v1 公告类型：新 摘要：检索能够识别出可能相关的过往轨迹，但它并未指明当用户、实体、约束条件或环境状态发生变化后，行动中的智能体应如何利用该轨迹。我们识别出这一检索后复用步骤是长时程轨迹记忆的一个独特瓶颈，并构建了一个评估框架，该框架在保持候选检索、目标状态、模型、解码和工具预算固定的同时，改变提供给智能体的支持。我们以查询条件复用（QCR）实例化该框架，这是一种刻意简化的目标导向注释，记录了可复用的程序、待恢复的绑定、适用条件和验证要求。QCR旨在检验复用假设，而非主张一种普遍偏好的记忆格式。在WebArena、WorkArena和AppWorld中的2,391个目标实例上，QCR达到了62.3%的平均成功率，比完整轨迹高出10.7个百分点，同时仅使用了48.9%的标记。
tldr: 本文提出查询条件复用（QCR）方法，通过简化的目标导向注释实现长时程智能体轨迹的有效复用，在多个基准上显著提升了成功率并降低了资源消耗。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Query-Conditioned Reuse (QCR), a simplified target-bound note for effective reuse of long-horizon agent trajectories, achieving higher success rates with lower token usage across multiple benchmarks.
